title: Associate Consultant / Manager Consulting Expert - DevOps Architect
description:
Founded in 1976, CGI is among the largest independent IT and business consulting services firms in the world. With 94,000 consultants and professionals across the globe, CGI delivers an end\-to\-end portfolio of capabilities, from strategic IT and business consulting to systems integration, managed IT and business process services and intellectual property solutions. CGI works with clients through a local relationship model complemented by a global delivery network that helps clients digitally transform their organizations and accelerate results. CGI Fiscal 2024 reported revenue is CA$14\.68 billion and CGI shares are listed on the TSX (GIB.A) and the NYSE (GIB). Learn more at cgi.com.  

  

Job Title: Associate Consultant / Manager Consulting Expert \- DevOps Architect  

Position: Associate Consultant / Manager Consulting Expert  

Experience: 12\-18 Years  

Category: Software development / Engineering  

Shift: General Shift  

Main location: Bangalore/Mumbai/ Chennai  

Position ID: J0626\-1452  

Employment Type: Full Time  

  

Position Description:  

12\+ years in DevOps, SRE, or Platform Engineering — you have rebuilt a slow, fragile pipeline before and can show the outcome. Deep hands\-on expertise in GitHub Actions (or equivalent); you write pipelines as production code, not YAML copy\-paste. Strong grasp of dependency analysis — build graphs, artifact registries, incremental compilation, and test\-impact analysis.  

Proven experience designing automated rollback and blue\-green or canary promotion strategies in a multi\-tenant environment. Comfortable with Terraform, Kubernetes (AKS), and policy\-as\-code – you can trace a change from Git commit to running workload. Communicates trade\-offs clearly to both engineering teams and leadership; writes the design doc before writing the code

**Your future duties and responsibilities**

* Audited and instrumented the end\-to\-end CI/CD pipeline to identify bottlenecks, analyze stage dependencies, and improve pipeline visibility through comprehensive dependency mapping and performance metrics.
* Redesigned the CI/CD architecture by implementing parallel execution, incremental builds, intelligent caching, artifact promotion, and reproducible environments to accelerate build and deployment cycles.
* Engineered automated rollback capabilities across deployment pipelines, ensuring every promotion stage was fully reversible without manual intervention to minimize release risks and downtime.
* Enhanced pipeline resilience by implementing flaky test isolation, configurable retry mechanisms, circuit breakers for external dependencies, and proactive monitoring with automated alerts to maintain pipeline reliability.
* Established automated quality gates incorporating unit, smoke, security, and policy validation checks to prevent unsafe deployments while preserving fast feedback and deployment velocity.
* Developed reusable DevOps frameworks, Infrastructure\-as\-Code modules, and standardized CI/CD templates, while documenting architectural decisions, conducting code reviews, and enabling seamless knowledge transfer to support long\-term maintainability and team adoption.

**Required qualifications to be successful in this role**


Education Qualification: Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field or higher with minimum 12\+ years of relevant experience.  

  

Must to Have:  

  

Azure Devops Automation, Coding/scripting, Kubernetes, Ansible, Docker, Container, Argo CD, ConfigMap, Terraform, Control plane. DevOps Engineering,Python¸ Groovy, Containerization¸ Github  

  

Good\-to\-Have Skills: Database, Sygnoz/NewRelic/Dynatrace, RDBMS understanding, Development/Automation background with proven work experience.  

  

\#LI\-SB15  

  

CGI is an equal opportunity employer. In addition, CGI is committed to providing accommodation for people with disabilities in accordance with provincial legislation. Please let us know if you require reasonable accommodation due to a disability during any aspect of the recruitment process and we will work with you to address your needs.

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
**Build Autonomous Cloud Systems as a Site Reliability Engineer**
=================================================================


Are you an early\-career engineer passionate about cloud security, site reliability, and automation? Trimble is seeking a Site Reliability Engineer (P1\) to join our Global AI Site Reliability \& Security Operations (AI\-SecOps) team. Operating across an enterprise Azure ecosystem of 22,000\+ Windows Virtual Machines and 3,000\+ Microsoft SQL Servers, you will combine SRE principles, Zero Trust architecture, and AI\-driven automation to ensure our systems remain secure, resilient, and highly available.

**About Us:**
-------------


Dedicated to the world’s tomorrow, Trimble is a technology company delivering solutions that enable our customers to work in new ways to measure, build, grow and move goods for a better quality of life. Core technologies in positioning, modeling, connectivity and data analytics connect the digital and physical worlds to improve productivity, quality, safety, transparency and sustainability. From purpose\-built products and enterprise lifecycle solutions to industry cloud services, Trimble is transforming critical industries such as construction, geospatial, agriculture and transportation to power an interconnected world of work. For more information about Trimble (NASDAQ: TRMB), visit: www.trimble.com

 **Our SecOps \& SRE Ecosystem:** Our AI\-SecOps team integrates cutting\-edge AI capabilities, automated patch orchestration, and DevSecOps pipelines to safeguard Trimble's enterprise infrastructure, ensuring compliance with global benchmarks while protecting global customer workflows.

**What Makes This Role Great:**
-------------------------------


As a P1 Site Reliability Engineer, you will contribute directly to multi\-year cloud security roadmaps, autonomous patching workflows, and AI\-driven CVE remediation under the mentorship of senior engineering leadership. Supporting a follow\-the\-sun model across North America and India, you will gain hands\-on exposure to enterprise\-scale Azure governance, modern observability tooling, and automated deployment pipelines. This role is an ideal launchpad for an ambitious engineer looking to master cloud reliability at scale.

**Key Exciting Responsibilities**
---------------------------------

* **Cloud Infrastructure Support:** Support the reliability and security strategy across our Azure infrastructure footprint, assisting in maintaining system stability and performance metrics.
* **Windows \& SQL Server Operations:** Help apply enterprise security configurations, patching standards, and operational guidelines across 22,000\+ Windows VMs and 3,000\+ SQL Servers.
* **Patch Orchestration \& Troubleshooting:** Participate in global patch deployment workflows (using tools like Azure Update Manager, NinjaOne, SCCM/MECM, WSUS, PatchMyPC, ManageEngine, or Ivanti) to prevent deployment failures.
* **Azure Governance \& Security:** Assist with Azure landing zone policies, RBAC access controls, Web Application Firewall (WAF) rule sets, and Zero Trust security protocols.
* **Vulnerability Analysis \& Remediation:** Execute routine CVE scans across platforms (Qualys, Tenable, Rapid7, Defender), utilizing AI tools and scripts for triage and automated patch deployment.
* **Automation \& Scripting:** Write and maintain scripts in PowerShell, Python, or Terraform to automate administrative tasks, continuous integration gates, and operational runbooks.
* **Incident Response \& Collaboration:** Support incident triage and root\-cause analysis (RCA) activities while collaborating closely with engineering teams in North America and India.

**Essential Skills \& Experience**
----------------------------------

* **Experience:** 2–3 years of hands\-on experience in cloud technical support, systems administration, DevOps, or site reliability engineering.
* **Cloud \& Security Foundations:** Fundamental understanding of Microsoft Azure, Azure Active Directory/Entra ID, RBAC, and basic cloud networking/security concepts.
* **Scripting \& Automation:** Introductory to intermediate skills in **PowerShell** or **Python** for task automation and system scripting.
* **OS \& Systems Familiarity:** Basic administration knowledge of Windows Server environments and familiarity with relational database management systems like MS SQL Server.
* **Analytical Mindset:** Strong problem\-solving aptitude, meticulous attention to detail, and a desire to learn modern AI\-assisted engineering practices.
* **Education:** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related discipline.

### **Bonus Points For:**

* **Certifications:** Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals (AZ\-900\), Azure Security Engineer Associate (AZ\-500\), or CompTIA Security\+.
* **Infrastructure as Code:** Exposure to enterprise IaC tools such as Terraform, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps pipelines.
* **Vulnerability Management:** Familiarity with CVSS scoring, patch management platforms, or common vulnerability scanning tools.

**Logistics:**
--------------

* **Grade / Level:** P1 (Entry Level)
* **Department:** Global AI Site Reliability \& Security Operations (AI\-SecOps)
* **Location:** Chennai
* **Job Type:** Full\-Time

**Why You'll Love Working With Us**
-----------------------------------


At Trimble, we're not just a company that "does good"—we are a team dedicated to making a tangible, positive Real\-World Impact. We build innovative solutions designed to solve the world's most critical challenges. From construction sites to transportation hubs, our work tangibly improves how people live, build, move, and grow.

* **You'll work on projects that truly matter:** Our purpose\-driven culture means you'll be helping to build and deliver solutions that make work faster, safer, and more sustainable for millions of people worldwide.
* **Collaborate with like\-minded people:** Our strong internal culture is a "hidden gem." You will work with a collaborative, supportive team that shares your purpose and fosters a genuine sense of belonging.
* **Be an owner:** Trimble thrives on individuals who take initiative and embrace ownership. You'll find an entrepreneurial spirit where success is often "self\-authored," empowering proactive "doers."
* **Enjoy true flexibility:** We offer flexible work arrangements, which are a significant driver for employees joining and staying with us.

 **How to Apply:** Please submit an online application for this position by clicking on the ‘Apply Now’ button located in this posting.

**Join a Values\-Driven Team: Belong, Grow, Innovate.**


At Trimble, our core values of Belong, Grow, and Innovate aren't just words—they're the foundation of our culture. We foster an environment where you are seen, heard, and valued (Belong); where you have an opportunity to build a career and drive our collective growth (Grow); and where your innovative ideas shape the future (Innovate). We believe in empowering local teams to create impactful strategies, ensuring our global vision resonates with every individual. Become part of a team where your contributions truly matter.

description:

For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well\-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**Location:** Bangalore or Chennai
  

**Shift:** US shift timings

* Develop and maintain **Ansible playbooks, roles, inventories, and automation workflows** for configuration management and orchestration.

description:

Location Chennai, India


Job typePermanent \| Contract typeFull Time


\#R\-00285183

  



**Join our digital revolution in NatWest Digital X**
----------------------------------------------------


In everything we do, we work to one aim. To make digital experiences which are effortless and secure.


So we organise ourselves around three principles: engineer, protect, and operate. We engineer simple solutions, we protect our customers, and we operate smarter.


**Job description**
-------------------


This role is based in India and as such all normal working days must be carried out in India.


Join us as a DevOps Engineer


* This is an opportunity for a driven individual to take on an exciting new career challenge
* You’ll focus on enhancing the integration of development and platform activities to improve deployment and system reliability
* It’s a chance to have a tangible effect on our function, put your existing skills to the test and advance your career
* We're offering this role at associate vice president level

**What you'll do**
------------------


As a DevOps Engineer, you’ll be responsible for designing and implementing solutions, driving automation, and optimising performance across the software development lifecycle. You’ll be securing buy\-in to DevOps methodologies from the Product Owner, Platform Lead, and other key business stakeholders, driving commitment to an alternative way of working.


We’ll look to you to build and leverage internal and external relationships to make sure that decisions made are commercially focused and create long\-term value for the bank. You’ll also be collaborating in the development of the DevOps strategy and roadmap aligned with business goals.


In addition, you’ll be:


* Designing and overseeing the architecture of systems and applications with a focus on scalability and reliability
* Analysing system performance and optimising infrastructure to improve efficiency and reduce costs
* Driving innovation by evaluating and integrating new technologies that enhance the DevOps ecosystem
* Leading the automation of advanced workflows, creating reusable modules and templates
* Making sure that practices align with compliance requirements and industry standards
* Communicating effectively with stakeholders to understand requirements and provide technical guidance

**The skills you'll need**
--------------------------
